lighting_notes: candlelight is the emotional centre; keep faces lit rather than silhouetted
avoid on-camera flash into a dark room if ambient light is usable
composition_taboos: shooting the cake with a blown-out background
missing the moment the candles are blown out
wardrobe_expectations: casual to festive, depending on the setting; children in party clothes
sensitive_handling: children must be photographed in ordinary, family-appropriate contexts only
